overreach: A supplied raw requirements excerpt lists occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating-band unwanted emissions / SEM, transmitter spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation, with transmitter intermodulation requiring an additional signal generator.
Spectrum / emissions as an effect of Wi-Fi 7/8 changes is not directly tied to Wi-Fi 7/8 in the provided RSE passages; the passages support RSE concepts and analyzer/EMI receiver usage generally.
review.reason: The answer's main conclusions about 320 MHz bandwidth, 4096QAM, MLO/multiple RF chains for Wi-Fi 7, and Wi-Fi 8 retaining core PHY parameters while adding dRU/UEQM test hurdles are well supported by the cited passages. It also appropriately caveats that 480 MHz is only a candidate waveform and that the passages do not provide formal EVM, phase-noise, synchronization, or Wi-Fi 8 normative limits; the only notable unsupported detail is the raw requirements excerpt attributed to passage [40], which is not provided among the passages.
